work.def: Energy moved into or out of a system by a force acting along a displacement: W = F d cos θ, a scalar in joules that can be positive, negative or zero.

work-energy-theorem.def: The net work done on an object equals its change in kinetic energy: W_net = ΔK.

force-position-graph.def: A graph of the force along the motion against position; the area under it is the work done by the force.

energy-transfer.def: Energy moving into or out of a system across its boundary, for example by work done by an external force.
